marco: Hi all — running the Go SDK quickstart and my first call from the sample server returns an HTML 502. Same workspace token works from the browser console. anyone seen this?

marco: command I ran: `./quickstart-go -api_key=$REDWOOD_API_KEY`

marco: response:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer ***
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: text/html

<html>502 Bad Gateway</html>
```

marco: token is a workspace token created in the Console. tried a service key inside the process and got 403.

elaine: FYI the Go SDK ships an aggressive retry policy by default. If a proxy or sidecar strips Authorization the SDK's retries can amplify the routing path and end up surfacing an HTML 502 instead of the API's JSON 402/401.

go-sdk-bot: Tip: SDKs should avoid retrying on unknown gateway HTML responses and surface the original body when possible.

onboard-bot: Heads up: Your org (pine-labs) does not have a billing method on file. First outbound requests may be gated until billing is added. https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/pine-labs/billing :credit_card:

marco: running curl from my laptop with the same workspace token returns 402 JSON: `\{"error":"org_billing_required","help":"https://console.redwood.ai/orgs/pine-labs/billing"\}`. inside the Go sample server it's the HTML 502. seems like header removal + retry amplification.

elaine: workaround: load a service key from a mounted file (`os.ReadFile`) inside the app to avoid header rewrites by intermediate proxies, or disable retries in quickstart config. also test `--network=host` to rule out runtime network proxies.

elaine: proposed fixes: 1) Go SDK: change default retry to avoid retrying on 5xx when content-type looks like HTML or when body contains gateway markers; 2) CLI/quickstart: perform a preflight org status/billing check and print a clear "billing required" message before making generation calls; 3) Docs: add a section on container/edge proxies that strip Authorization and recommended secret-file patterns.

marco: i'll open eng/devex ticket with the minimal Go sample, host vs process curl traces, headers, and the service-key-file workaround. tagging @elaine. thanks! :pray:
